About this item

  • #1 Dentist recommended oral b io: This Oral-B Braun electric toothbrush removes up to 100 %* more plaque in just 1 week; these bristles are clinically proven to remove up to 2x healthier gums vs manual brush
  • Intelligent gum protection: Features a smart pressure sensor that alerts you if you press too hard, too soft, or just right; designed to protect sensitive gums and enamel; compatible with round replacement brush heads
  • Real-time Brushing Guidance: Utilize the Oral-B app's AI-powered tracking to map your brushing habits in real-time; ensures you never miss a spot; achieve a deep clean across teeth, tongue and cheeks with our premium electric toothbrushes
  • Smart Timer and Effortless Maintenance: The iO Light Ring Timer keeps the dentist recommended two-minutes brushing time; refill change alert indicates when to replace your brush head every 3 months**; switch carefree with a 30-day guarantee
  • Personalized smart brushing: Features five dynamic cleaning modes including Daily Clean, Sensitive, Whitening, Gum Care, and Intense Clean; customized settings adapt to your specific oral hygiene goals to protect sensitive teeth and gums
  • Convenient on the go oral care: Long-lasting charge that lasts up to 2 weeks; includes a 3-hour fast charger, 2 refill heads and built-in charger travel case

  • Ali Loves To Share
    5 out of 5 stars
    Finally!! This one is perfect!
    Reviewed in the United States on December 13, 2025
    Color: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Take in mind when you read most electric toothbrush reviews, they are coming from manual so OF COURSE YOUR TEETH FEEL AMAZING AND CLEAN, but what about when you’re coming from a really good electric toothbrush (Phillips Sonicare and another cheaper one that both felt like improvements after manual) and there are so many choices without a clear understanding what makes one $79 while another is over $200? I started to go a little crazy trying to figure it out. I asked one dentist to suggest and she said either oral b or sonicare (she doesn’t sell them at the office) while another said oral b (he did sell them) so that was not really helpful. When pressed my dentist who doesn’t sell them prefers oral b and she likes the smaller head. I GET THAT NOW! It’s like I’m polishing each tooth and wrapping the head around the tooth almost and I LOVE THAT! I think the Phillips isn’t getting in between near as well. The thing about either brand is that there is such a wide price range that I couldn’t tell the real $100 difference other than maybe an app and possibly more cleaning modes but that’s about it. I decided to go with oral b to try this round more precise head and went to their website to take the quiz to see what was best for me and this is where I landed. I wanted to stay under $100 (and you can on Black Friday and other big sales but I missed it and paid $119 which isn’t terrible if it’s significantly better than my last electric). I just used it for the first time and MY TEETH FEEL AMAZING , in fact my whole mouth feels so clean. I’m someone who buys a firmer bristle head (NOT HARD but I need to feel scrubbed if makes sense). I think sometimes I may be hard on my gums trying to really scrub my teeth but the happy medium is in this oral b brush head! I’m just not clear which one it is as it came with 2 and says one is ultimate clean and the other is gentle care. I’m assuming it’s ultimate but it’s soft but really dense and just scrubs but it’s gentle on the gums. Love it. Very satisfied. It’s not loud at all and it’s got a great light sensor that indicates when you’re at the perfect pressure. I actually found it quite helpful and it’s clearly visible even if you’re not looking in the mirror. I’m kind of excited about the app because after a long lifetime of heat checkups, something has gone wrong and I’m facing some pretty big restorative dental work so perhaps I’ve been slacking I don’t know But I’m trying to be very diligent and that’s part of the reason for the new purchase. I also felt like my old one wasn’t getting me as clean as it used it so it could be I needed something more aggressive. This is really perfect and considering the price tags you can easily go up to on the big name models, I think this really is the sweet spot for an electric toothbrush ESPECIALLY IF YOU’RE NOT COMING FROM MANUAL. If you’re coming from manual, any real electric toothbrush will be so impressive but I needed to be impressed after exclusively using electric. This is it. I’ve got no doubt about the battery life.. they are all that way.. the travel case is a great touch and it’s nice. Nothing like having your electric toothbrush go off in your closed suitcase when you’re all packed. lol. I was always able to get off brand replacement heads for my sonicare that were great at a fraction of the price. I’ll be interested to see if I can get a real match to this one otherwise it may be worth it to stick brand name. Here’s to your dental health and perfect check ups.

    Great toothbush - your dentist will love you again
    Reviewed in the United States on December 14, 2025
    Color: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is truly an amazing toothbrush. I find this does a much better job of cleaning my teeth and removing plaque. The features are pretty cool-it's the little things, right? You can change the colors of light (where the pressure sensor is) with multiple options. It has a magnetic charger at the base. The case has a charger feature which is a great feature-it comes with a cord and a power adapter-you can't even get that for $1300 cell phones anymore. It even has an interactive display-yes I like the smiley face when I'm done. I haven't tried the app yet, I've been brushing for a long time without one but I'll give it a shot because I do enjoy technology. This is quieter than my first Oral B but still sounds like a small drone in my head, still fairly quiet. The bristles are comfortable. Battery life is pretty good so far. Best part? I got it for a great deal when it was on sale last week. This is light years better than their competitor (rhymes with monic air) which I purchased for a lot more and wish I had returned when I had the chance. I hate it so much I'm willing to give a $200 toothbrush away. It may not be the newest in the iO line but I'm really impressed so far. Time will tell on how durable it is but I'm going to stay with the Oral Be family.

    Wow. This Oral B is a big improvement over the one I replaced. It’s whisper quiet in comparison, and I really like the pressure sensor light (green if good pressure, red if too much pressure, white if too little pressure). I also like that I can set the brush mode (speed) to “sensitive”, which is what I use exclusively with a sensitive brush head. My older Oral B only oscillated. This newer one both oscillates and micro-vibrates.

    My old Oral B was about 10-12 yrs old. It still worked perfectly. Buying sensitive brushes had become fairly inexpensive. I’m pretty sure it would have kept on working at least another 5 yrs. However, my hygienist repeatedly told me: “You’re not doing this, you’re not doing that, blah blah blah.” Tiresome. Sometimes the brush would strike under the gum line around a crown and cause lingering pain.

    I learned about the new Oral B with the pressure sensor and decided to buy one. Here was the surprising thing to me: I wasn’t brushing hard enough, at least according to the pressure sensor. The first time I used it, I was repeatedly in the white zone (too little pressure).

    Also, here’s the thing that really did it for me, I didn’t really know how to brush correctly. I found a video on YouTube (“Tips On How To Brush with an Oral B Electric Toothbrush” by Murmann Dental Health) that explained and demonstrated exactly how to brush using an Oral B with pressure sensor. That was very illuminating. I highly recommend that or a similar video. The thing that stood out from the video was that our teeth are rounded, so we need to wrap the brush around each individual tooth .

    I’ve been following what I learned in the video. So far, the brush hasn’t caused pain under the gum line. The IO sensitive brush along with the “sensitive” setting on the device have been a more comfortable brushing experience for me. I’m consistently in the green zone. Hopefully, it all makes a difference at my next dental appointment.

    I was sorry to see my old Oral B go as it was still useful, but sometimes useful doesn’t mean effective or appropriate for teeth & gum challenges. It can still be useful for other purposes.

    I have never used the app, so no comment there.

    The travel case is very nice and will come in handy. The only thing I don’t like about it is it doesn’t include storage for what seems to be a proprietary charger. The charger is two-pin, and I guess it’s supposedly safer to use in wet environments; you may need to include it in your travel bag depending on your travel time.

    5 stars from me.

    I bought my first oral b in 2016, what would be the equivalent of this model back then. I’ve thoroughly enjoyed it, and used it religiously all these years and it’s still going strong but the rubber face is starting to degrade so I figured I’d upgrade. I was NOT expecting the technology to have advanced so much, it is MUCH more powerful than the old style, with much less vibration and noise. It feels like I’m achieving the same clean in half the time with this one, and the new brush head style doesn’t have that stupid hole that dribbles toothpaste slobber all over your face like the old one. The screen is an added “cool factor” but doesn’t really offer a life changing upgrade aside from being able to see the battery percentage. The new charging dock design is nice, makes it easier to wipe clean without the little peg in the middle. All in all, this is a very nice upgrade and well worth the price. Here’s to the next 10 years of compliments from my dentist!

    5 out of 5 stars
    Meilleur brosse à dents avec un suivis avec l’application
    Reviewed in Canada on June 26, 2026
    Color: Black

    Après plusieurs semaines d’utilisation, je peux dire que la brosse à dents électrique Oral-B iO7 a largement dépassé mes attentes. Dès la première utilisation, on ressent une réelle différence au niveau de la propreté des dents. Elles sont lisses, propres et donnent une sensation comparable à celle d’un nettoyage professionnel chez le dentiste.

    La prise en main est excellente et la brosse est très confortable à utiliser. Les différents modes de brossage permettent d’adapter le nettoyage selon les besoins, que ce soit pour un nettoyage quotidien, en douceur ou plus intensif. Le capteur de pression est un excellent ajout, car il aide à éviter de brosser trop fort et protège les gencives.

    L’autonomie est très bonne et la recharge est simple grâce à la base magnétique. J’apprécie également l’application Oral-B, qui permet de suivre chaque séance de brossage, de voir si toutes les zones de la bouche ont été correctement nettoyées, d’obtenir des statistiques sur ses habitudes et de recevoir des conseils pour améliorer sa technique. C’est une fonctionnalité très utile qui aide à adopter une meilleure routine d’hygiène bucco-dentaire.

    Points forts :

    * Nettoyage exceptionnel et sensation de dents très propres.

    * Fonctionnement silencieux et très agréable.

    * Plusieurs modes de brossage adaptés à différents besoins.

    * Capteur de pression efficace pour protéger les gencives.

    * Suivi détaillé des brossages avec l’application Oral-B.

    * Conseils personnalisés et statistiques de progression.

    * Excellente autonomie de la batterie.

    * Qualité de fabrication haut de gamme.

    * Recharge magnétique pratique.

    En résumé, la Oral-B iO7 est une brosse à dents électrique de très grande qualité qui offre une expérience de brossage nettement supérieure à une brosse manuelle. Les fonctionnalités connectées avec l’application ajoutent une réelle valeur en permettant de suivre et d’améliorer ses habitudes de brossage au fil du temps. Malgré un prix plus élevé, les performances, le confort d’utilisation et les fonctionnalités justifient largement l’investissement. Je la recommande sans hésitation à toute personne souhaitant améliorer son hygiène bucco-dentaire.

About this Item

  • #1 Dentist recommended oral b io: This Oral-B Braun electric toothbrush removes up to 100 %* more plaque in just 1 week; these bristles are clinically proven to remove up to 2x healthier gums vs manual brush
  • Intelligent gum protection: Features a smart pressure sensor that alerts you if you press too hard, too soft, or just right; designed to protect sensitive gums and enamel; compatible with round replacement brush heads
  • Real-time Brushing Guidance: Utilize the Oral-B app's AI-powered tracking to map your brushing habits in real-time; ensures you never miss a spot; achieve a deep clean across teeth, tongue and cheeks with our premium electric toothbrushes
  • Smart Timer and Effortless Maintenance: The iO Light Ring Timer keeps the dentist recommended two-minutes brushing time; refill change alert indicates when to replace your brush head every 3 months**; switch carefree with a 30-day guarantee
  • Personalized smart brushing: Features five dynamic cleaning modes including Daily Clean, Sensitive, Whitening, Gum Care, and Intense Clean; customized settings adapt to your specific oral hygiene goals to protect sensitive teeth and gums
  • Convenient on the go oral care: Long-lasting charge that lasts up to 2 weeks; includes a 3-hour fast charger, 2 refill heads and built-in charger travel case

Product Description

The Oral-B iO Deep Clean + Protect combines powerful, but gentle micro vibrations with Oral-B's dentist inspired round brush head to deliver 100% cleaner teeth versus a regular manual toohtbrush.
